title: How to Leave The Mall World, a Guide
content: 1. Pray Pray both outside of The Mall World, while in real life, and also pray when you are in The Mall World. Once you get better at praying while in real life, you will be able to pray better while sleeping. Prayer will instantly remove you from The Mall World or any other astral realms our soul becomes lost in during sleep. 2. Love your Parents Heal your relationship with your parents. If you parents are Narcissists or don't love you, still try to repair your relationship with your mother. Even if a person's mother is evil it is still wrong to not love and respect her since we came into this world through her. As for fathers, there are some cases where a father is genuinely evil and it's best not to speak to them, but I think this is much rarer than people think. My advice is to try to genuinely try to love your father for a certain amount of time, but if you find it's not possible, then you can abandon them, however still forgive them and wish only the best for them. 3. Retract your consent to have your organs donated after death with the DMV/government. 4. Retract all soul-contracts “My body is my property and I do not agree to malevolent beings owning or modifying my body.” “I do not consent to being in The Mall World” “I do not consent for malevolent beings to interact with me! “I do not want to be in The Mall World, let me out now!” “I wish the highest good for all involved in The Mall World, but I do not want to be there ever again!” “In the name of God I demand to be freed from The Mall World now! 5. Fight back When you are in The Mall World, state your affirmations that you do want to be there. Put your heart behind your words. You are only in The Mall World because of your consent, or your consent from a past life. Just like in a call with a Comcast customer service agent who’s making it difficult for you to cancel your subscription, be assertive but not aggressive and demand to be canceled.
